name: SquidStats
description: A modern tool for parsing and analyzing Squid logs, providing a sleek and user-friendly dashboard to visualize real-time connection data. Includes Squid proxy server pre-configured for immediate use.

notes.text: SquidStats is accessible at http://YOUR_IP:5000 with default credentials (admin/admin). Change password immediately after first login.
Squid proxy is running on port 3128. Configure clients to use this proxy or connect to a remote Squid instance by editing /opt/SquidStats/.env
For remote Squid setup, configure log forwarding via rsyslog or syslog-ng. See the official documentation for detailed instructions.
